command:

find $WORKSPACE/.bos/worktrees -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name .git -print 2>/dev/null
find $WORKSPACE/.bos/worktrees -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name .git -print 2>/dev/null'
